# New Computer Modern web fonts

Source: https://mirrors.ctan.org/fonts/newcomputermodern.zip (version 8.1.1).
Author: Antonis Tsolomitis. See License.txt for distribution terms.

These WOFF2 files are subsets of the regular, bold, italic, and bold italic
NewCM10 fonts. They retain U+0000–024F, U+2000–206F, and U+2212 for the
résumé’s Latin text, punctuation, and symbols. FontTools produced the subsets
and WOFF2 conversion; unsupported metadata tables were dropped.
